# opnsense_quagga_ospf_prefixlist (Data Source)

Reads one OPNsense OSPFv2 prefix-list entry by UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the prefix-list entry.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Whether matching routes are permitted or denied.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this prefix-list entry is enabled.
- `name` (String) Name of the prefix list.
- `network` (String) Network prefix matched by this entry.
- `sequence_number` (Number) Sequence number used to order this prefix-list entry.
